args.subject: PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living
args.body:
Hi June,

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb.
- "PHL" is ambiguous: it also matches Pellucid Harbor Logistics (Gulf Coast terminal rows). Use the full name in searches and reports.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". It should be relabelled to Pellow Home Living so the supervisor stops searching under the old name.
- Sofia Marchetti (Coastal team) owns the account; Bettina Kroll is covering the queue.

Sent via assistant on behalf of Sofia Marchetti.
